title: Working on my game. Need some feedback on the demo
author: JustAPerson599
selftext:
I made Constellation Clicker, where you begin with a single star and a modest source of income, click to generate capital, claim nearby systems, and connect worlds through profitable interstellar routes. Every star offers resources that support different industries, encouraging you to plan where you expand and how each new system contributes to your growing economy.



**I'm looking for people to playtest demo builds and give me their honest opinions about the mechanics and some ideas on what would be good to include! If you are an idle game/incremental/clicker fan, I welcome your feedback!**

  
Download or play on web on [itchio here](https://xixoguy.itch.io/constellation-clicker).

If you like it you can wishlist it on [Steam here.](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5015470/Constellation_Clicker/)
